input: Pinchot 1960 and 1962; Griffiths & Chaplain 1962; Painter & Hunter 1970 (abstract: 'may represent the type reaction'); Griffiths 1976 (abstract: 'analogous to those of substrate-level phosphorylation').

input: Rivalry [C, S, W]. input: Neumann & Jagendorf 1964, Jagendorf & Uribe 1966 (Spinacia oleracea NCBITaxon:3562); Racker & Stoeckenius 1974 (Halobacterium salinarum NCBITaxon:2242); Hitchens & Kell 1982, 1983 (NCBITaxon:1061); all on a respiratory-chain claim.

correct: Supports proton coupling; at odds with Mitchell's redox-loop scheme for complex IV (UNVERIFIED, memory).

correct: Chemiosmosis stayed accepted (Ernster 1978; Harold 2001).

input: W's mediator is CHEBI:15378 refined by located_in GO:0005743 (curie CHEBI:15378&RO:0001025=(GO:0005743)). The core's Entity.refineAxiom states it is_a hydron at 0.999, so W's claim implies C's.

title: An undercutter, not a rebuttal (van der Bend 1985)
input: Van der Bend 1985 (PMID 2996506): liposomes with bacteriorhodopsin and ATP synthase and no specific contact reproduce the 'localized' signatures but one: the effect of uncouplers at different levels of ATP synthase inhibition.
